mapper.select: SELECT CASE QUARTER() WHEN 1 THEN '第一季度' WHEN 2 THEN '第二季度' WHEN 3 THEN '第三季度' WHEN 4 THEN '第四季度' END as label, COUNT(*) as value FROM company_users cu WHERE YEAR() = #{year} AND cu.audit_status = 1 GROUP BY CASE QUARTER() WHEN 1 THEN '第一季度' WHEN 2 THEN '第二季度' WHEN 3 THEN '第三季度' WHEN 4 THEN '第四季度' END, QUARTER() ORDER BY QUARTER()
mapper.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sis.student_id) FROM student_internship_status sis JOIN position admitted_position ON admitted_position.id = sis.position_id WHERE admitted_position.company_id = cu.id AND admitted_position.status IN ('active', 'paused') AND sis.status IN (1, 2, 3) AND COALESCE(sis.recall_status, 0) != 2
mapper.select: SELECT cu.id, cu.company_name, AS audit_time, COALESCE(SUM(p.planned_recruit), 0) as position_count, () as admitted_count, CASE cu.status WHEN 1 THEN '正常' WHEN 0 THEN '已禁用' ELSE '未知' END as status, cu.company_tag FROM company_users cu LEFT JOIN position p ON cu.id = p.company_id AND p.status IN ('active', 'paused') WHERE cu.audit_status = 1 GROUP BY cu.id, cu.company_name, cu.audit_time, cu.create_time, cu.status, cu.company_tag ORDER BY DESC, cu.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cu.id) FROM company_users cu WHERE cu.audit_status = 1

SELECT m.id, d.name as college, m.name as major_name, COUNT(su.id) as total_count, COALESCE(COUNT(CASE WHEN sis.status IN (2, 3, 4) THEN 1 END), 0) as internship_count, CASE WHEN COUNT(su.id) > 0 THEN ROUND(COALESCE(COUNT(CASE WHEN sis.status IN (2, 3, 4) THEN 1 END), 0) * 100.0 / COUNT(su.id), 1) ELSE 0 END as internship_rate FROM major m LEFT JOIN department d ON m.department_id = d.id LEFT JOIN student_users su ON m.id = su.major_id LEFT JOIN student_internship_status sis ON su.id = sis.student_id GROUP BY m.id, d.name, m.name ORDER BY m.id LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.id) FROM major m
